description: Tracks versions pinned where no Renovate manager can see them (inside run: scripts, input defaults, Makefiles). Put a comment on the line directly above the pin:  # renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name> [versioning=<scheme>] [extractVersion=<regex>]  followed by NAME=value, NAME: value or default: value.

customManagers.description: # renovate: annotations above a pinned version
